name: The Tyrant
source: The game tells about the son, who returns from his year abroad as an exchange student. It was his last year of school and he comes home to find a job, however upon his return he notices that some things have changed a lot for his family. His mother, his step-dad and his two sisters now live a cheaper house, as part of his step-dad's new position as an undercover cop. He pretends to be a low ranking muscle of a crime boss and the whole family plays along this deception.
translation: 游戏讲述了儿子作为交换生从国外回来一年的故事。这是他在学校的最后一年，他回家找工作，但回来后他发现家里的一些事情发生了很大的变化。他的母亲、他的继父和他的两个姐妹现在住在一套更便宜的房子里，这是他继父作为卧底警察的新职位的一部分。他假装自己是犯罪头目的低级人物，全家人都参与了这种欺骗。
